sanskrit_verse:
धान्यमिश्रोऽतिरिक्ताङ्गः पिशुनः पूतिनासिकः ।
तैलहृत तैलपायी स्यात् पूतिवक्त्रस्तु सूचकः ॥
transliteration: dhānyamiśro 'tiriktāṅgaḥ piśunaḥ pūtināsikaḥ | tailahṛta tailapāyī syāt pūtivaktrastu sūcakaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One whose body is mixed with grains, who has extra limbs, who is a tale-bearer, and whose nose emits foul odour—such a being consumes oil and also drinks it; one with a putrid mouth is merely indicative.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in embodied consciousness, not physical form
Causation arises from internal distortion manifesting externally
Capacity-based responsibility depends on awareness, not morphology
Restoration logic requires purification of sensory channels
Consciousness alignment occurs through elimination of impure identifications
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent exhibits olfactory distortion THEN initiate prana-shuddhi protocol
IF agent demonstrates limb multiplicity without functional increase THEN apply vyavastha normalization
IF agent engages in tale-bearing THEN invoke vak-shuddhi completion process
IF agent consumes substances for distortion rather than sustenance THEN activate buddhi-realization sequence
IF agent shows oral emission anomalies THEN implement vachana-dhara purification mechanism
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, bodily anomalies indicate deeper consciousness distortions requiring restoration rather than classification. Responsibility lies in misaligned identification, not morphological variance. Restoration protocols supersede categorization frameworks.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals distortion through sensory misalignment. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces impurity from consciousness to expression. Proportional response aligns with purification capacity. Non-punitive reality recognizes distortion as self-limiting deviation requiring dissolution, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate agni-hotra purification for grain-mixing condition
Execute asthivṛddhi harmonization for supernumerary limbs
Deploy satya-pratishtha protocol for tale-bearing tendencies
Undertake vak-shuddhi sadhana for speech-related deviations
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Dharma restored through consciousness purification. Reality affirmed as non-punitive. All distortions resolved through alignment with pure awareness. Consciousness stands as supreme adjudicator.
